verdict.rationale: Titan Security Key is a hardware FIDO authenticator with no automation or workflow layer, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is outside its product category. The evidence covers only enrollment, pairing, reset, and sign-in. The probe also confirms it ships no CLI, SDK, or API surface of its own.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
